assumptions: E is any real inner-product normed additive group; g,p:E→E, eta>=0.

steps.text: Cauchy-Schwarz gives ||d||²<=||x-y||||d||. The zero case is immediate; otherwise norm d is strictly positive, so cancellation is legitimate. This is the exact existing argument moved into one shared module.
